answer: An epoch pays only heads that spend their own future. To be credited, a head must etch an irrevocable waiver of every epoch it will ever claim again into the public quartz plate, and the forfeited stream is paid to the honest pool that graded it. Standing makes the burn bite: each head is its own island of earned attestations, so a fresh head has nothing to burn and a farm must age every head for epochs before it can cash one, and the tenth head costs ten epochs of ageing. The burn is address-bound - a sibling's spiral cannot refill a neighbour's plate.
